raw_segments.text: Glorious tone he has still, cork air softer also their brogue, silly man could have made
oceans of money, singing wrong words, wore out his wife, now sings, but hard to tell.
Only the two themselves, if he doesn't break down, keep a trot for the avenue.
His hands and feet sing too, drink, nerves overstrung, must be abstemious to sing.
